_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Muntu wa kutelekesha kwa {width}x{height} mukwakwa.
Ine ule muntu {player_id}. Vintu vya kusoka: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' kana w/s/a/d.
Kusudi: kupumula kwa muda wote. Njila zinawopa; kugongana na kuta kunawopa; kugongana kwa musu kunawopa wote wawili.

board.after_moves:
Bodi baada ya mitala ya wakati mmoja:
{board}

game_action.invalid_death: Mukwetu {player_id} akufwa kwa sababu ya mtala usio sahihi.

outcome.turn_limit: Muda wa zamu umefikia - mshindi ni mrefu zaidi.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Vikundi vya mwisho vya daraja (bora→mbaya zaidi): {groups}
